152000.description: Kansai farmgirl gets spooked by a bee.
synonyms: Ah knew in mah head, but...

title.native: 頭では分かってんだけど・・・
酷い目に遭う男の子たち

title.romaji: Boku to Kimi no Shiawase Kekkonshiki

152006.description:
This is my beautiful hell.

Is it so wrong to want something so badly, that you'll do whatever it takes to have it?

(Source: xxLaLa, translated)

title.native: 砂糖菓子は苦くてもろい

152008.description:
An actor who was usually just an anonymous samurai soldier finally got the chance to play the role of the warlord Okita Soji. When he woke up from a nap, he found himself back in the bloody world near the end of the Edo period, in the body of Okita Soji himself!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

152009.description:
We join mage Lulu as she’s tasked with accompanying her country’s saviour, the beautiful beastmaster Harmony, on the long adventure back home.

Notes:
- The first 3 chapters were released as a web manga in 2008.
- Chapter Count Includes 1 Extra Chapter

title.native: きゅーてぃーびーすと

152010.description:
Sae and Sawano are university students. One day, Sawano confessed his love to Sae, who has always liked him, too, and Sae is full of happiness. Sawano, on the other hand, had a disturbing prophetic dream...? A collection including the titular story and four other short stories.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

Collected Stories:
1. Toiki to Inazuma (吐息と稲妻)
2. Hoshizora Swimmer (星空スイマー)
3. Yuki no Joou (雪の女王)
4. Niji Megane (ニジメガネ)
5. Haru Oi (春追い)

152011.description:
This is an autobiographical story about the hard-core otaku Hiroki Iida's search for a gay marriage partner, adapted into essay comic form by Harekawa Sinta.

"I just want to find someone that's right for me," that was Hiroki's goal when he got into "matchmaking." As he meets all sorts of different men, he himself will grow as a person, too.

(Source: MF Fleur, translated)

title.native: ぼくのはじめてゲイ婚活

152012.description:
My name is Shen Yao. I am the envy of all the ladies in the imperial capital, because I grew up as the childhood friend of the royal family, and I'm engaged to become the Crown Prince Consort. But in reality, I don't like the Crown Prince at all, and I wished I could break off the engagement. The Fifth Prince is moody and unpredictable, and he has always messed with me since we were young. The Crown Prince seemed fine and I liked him at first. But as we grew up, he started to act strangely, like he’s a different person. Then suddenly out of nowhere, he wanted to break off the engagement! Fine, palace intrigue is so complicated, let's get out of here!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

152013.description:
Lars, a young orphan, has been striving to improve his healing spell since suffering a certain traumatic event. After ten years of trying, it's still a beginners' heal, and his fellow villagers only see him as a burden. Finally, Lars decides to leave the village for a bigger town and discoverers a secret side to his healing powers. Once the most useless person in his village, Lars's life is about to change completely in this new land!

A rebirth fantasy based on an original story from Shōsetsuka ni Narō!

(Source: K-Manga)

title.native: 極めたヒールがすべてを癒す！～村で無用になった僕は、拾ったゴミを激レアアイテムに修繕して成り上がる！～
title.romaji: Kiwameta Heal ga Subete wo Iyasu!: Mura de Muyou ni Natta Boku wa, Hirotta Gomi wo Geki-Rare Item ni Shuuzen shite Nariagaru!

152014.description: Finally hearing those much-wanted words, it was now impossible to say the same.
synonyms: The Diary of the End: Zetsu

title.native: 終わりの日記帳 絶
終わりの日記帳　絶儚フルカラー
title.romaji: Owari no Nikkichou: Zetsubou Full Color

title.native: ヘンな処女でもいいですか？
title.romaji: Hen na Ko demo Ii desu ka?

152017.description:
Emilia was a botanist who had no interest whatsoever in romance. Her only focus was researching rare plants. One day, she headed out on an expedition to the snow-covered mountains and fell off a cliff. But when she woke up, she found herself in another world. She was no longer a scientist but a goddess sent from the heavens, destined to save a nation. And the emperor she'd just engaged to, Adrian, threatens her that she must never leave but fulfill her god-given duty. Determined to return to her lab, Emelia finds ways to escape her fate. But slowly, she finds herself drawn to her fiance. What will become of Emelia? Will she be able to return to her old life?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

152018.description:
The master of the Izakaya "Arakan" is also a famous detective. In accordance with the veteran police detective Numata's request, he joins the investigations. A gruelling detective story blended lightly with cuisine and seasoned with some human drama.

(Souce: Media Do / Bookwalker)

152019.description:
Leo Mikuni is past praying to gods. Having cast all pretty notions of kindness aside, he's drawn to the occult, which affirms his all-consuming negative emotions. He knows his solace in demons is only a temporary solution to his problems, but summoning demons is the only thing that keeps his loneliness at bay. One day, when he's performing a stress-relieving summoning ritual, a handsome, scowling man dressed in black appears in a crash of lightning. A real demon in the flesh! Thrilled beyond belief, Leo accepts the demon into his home. But, it doesn't stop there. The demon demands he accept him in bed...! Leo's difficult life drives him to worship demons, but one day, a summoning ritual turns real and brings a handsome demon into his home!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: マイ・バッド・ペインキラー

152020.description:
"You need to learn to share with others."

My father made me sponsor a child since I was student. However, I had no idea it was not an ordinary donation, and that's how I met this really pretty girl.

"Are you my sponsor?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

152021.description: Adaptation of Rampo Edogawa's novel of the same name.

152023.description:
1. Ai wa Douda! (愛はどうだ！)
2. Gohan ni Shiyou! (ごはんにしよう！)
3. Futari no Portrait (ふたり肖像)

152024.description:
Kaoru Umeno got into college and moved to Tokyo to chase after her beloved senpai. But when she visits her senpai's room she finds a naked woman!? Not only that, because of a blunder she has to live in the boys dorm... At those dorms there is..!??

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

synonyms: World’s End Nosferatu: The Wandering Life of Selen (Night and Day)

title.native: 死なないセレンの昼と夜 ―世界の終わり、旅する吸血鬼―
title.romaji: Shinanai Selen no Hiru to Yoru: Sekai no Owari, Tabi Suru Kyuuketsuki

152026.description:
When her father remarries, Chiharu suddenly has four new brothers. They're all good-looking and kind...which is no surprise, since all four of them work as hosts! They all start living together, but actually Chiharu doesn't really like hosts, so she tries to draw a line somewhere. Then, the second son, Minami, who had been nice before, suddenly starts chasing after her! "If you won't do what I say, why don't I just force you?" he says devilishly, and starts messing around with Chiharu "down there"...! Thus begins her life with these four suddenly changed hosts...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 初恋同棲～イケメンホスト4兄弟に狙われた7日間～
title.romaji: Hatsukoi Dousei: Ikemen Host 4 Kyoudai ni Nerawareta 7-ka Kan

152027.description:
"A mirage appears on the sea from time to time... They say if you see it with someone you love, then you are meant to be." I'm really into Kaneto: he's way cooler and better-looking than the other boys... I can't stop dreaming about about when I was younger. I still remember how warm his hands were. This compilation contains five short comics: "Real Romance and Your Heat"; "Secret Romance"; "A Warm Hand"; "The Teacher's Secret"; and the controversial "Young Mito Komon".

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: カプエルちゃんは見てほしい

152029.description: A compilation of fluffy romance short stories that are so sweet and gentle it'll make you swoon over it.

152030.description:
This exciting story is about a girl who assumes she can increase her "girl power" by defeating monsters.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, Okuni-chan, a high school sophomore, is ordered by Six (the beautiful sixth demon queen) to contain the violent monsters ravaging the human world.
The story of this idealistic teenage girl is full of laughter and tears!

(Source: Heroes, translated)

title.native: ドロロン! お国ちゃん

152032.description:
An earnest little demon ends up in dire straits as he's summoned by a human with a libido rivaling that of a devil.
A college student Satoru Shiiyama had a crush on Jun Mariya ever since middle school, but the object of his affections dies in an accident. In the midst of his grieving, Satoru accidentally summons a demon and gets a once-in-a-lifetime offer: "In return for your life span, I'll grant you a wish." Having lost all hope, Satoru agrees. Just what is the wish that he made...?
This is a heart-warming(?) love story between a selfish, lustful guy and an honest, cute little demon.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Also includes 3 chapters of Mariya-kun to Shinigami-chan (毬谷くんと死神さん).

title.native: なきむし悪魔のマリアくん

152033.description:
After quitting his horrible office job, Kojiro's been enjoying the slow life, working part time at a convenience store. One day, he finds a wallet and returns it to its owner, Koga, who turns out to be a wolf in sheep's clothing...!
Koga's the CEO of an IT startup, and he's so weirdly intent on paying Kojiro back for his trouble, it's intimidating! But, when they get to talking, he's surprisingly kind, and Kojiro finds himself opening up to him.

Faced with his polar opposite, a vulnerable young man of simple tastes, Koga catches feelings he's never had before... He knows he shouldn't, but this meek, defenseless hamster of a man provokes his predatory instincts... Koga just has to hunt him down!

Eyes locked on his prey, this predator's poised and ready to lunge...!
Now, it's eat or be eaten... well, really, for Kojiro, it's just being eaten...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Tiger on the Prowl -For a Sensitive Hamster-
title.native: 強欲タイガー～愛しの敏感ハムスター
title.romaji: Gouyoku Tiger: Itoshi no Binkan Hamster

152034.description:
Rule one of harboring a secret crush: never get your hopes up. Especially if your crush is the nicest person you’ve ever seen. Yeon-U’s kind, thoughtful, and gentle—everything that Gyu-Yeong wants his significant other to be. The problem is that Yeon-U’s nice to everyone, not just Gyu-Yeong. Gyu-Yeong knows that he’s not special to Yeon-U, but sometimes he wants to give in to the little voice in his heart. Maybe all of this does mean something, maybe Yeon-U thinks that he’s special, maybe Gyu-Yeong will be allowed to build his hopes up, just this once.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19.
synonyms: 優しくしないで〜俺だけ特別扱いです!?〜

152035.description:
Ahyeon has harbored feelings for his next-door neighbor and close hyung, Seokjun ever since they were children. However, Ahyeon's world crumbles when he hears that Seokjun's affection was merely a facade. Heartbroken, Ahyeon flees abroad to pursue studies, hoping to escape the pain of his unrequited love. Upon his return to Korea, fate intertwines their paths once more as Ahyeon discovers that Seokjun is now the president of the company where he was hired! Despite his attempts to move on, Ahyeon finds himself trapped in a cycle of embarrassment whenever Seokjun's flirtatious advances resurface in the workplace, reopening wounds he thought had healed. Will Ahyeon be able to confront his feelings and navigate this unexpected proximity with his first love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

152036.description:
Seol Jaeha and Lee Hyun have been best friends since childhood. They do nearly everything together, and despite Jaeha’s unprecedented popularity at school, he only has eyes for Hyun. Enter the new transfer student (and Jaeha’s personal nightmare), Kim Doyoung. Hyun and Doyoung spend more and more time together every day, leaving less time for Jaeha to make his move. What’s worse, Doyoung is icing him out for some unknown reason, all while growing ever closer to Hyun. The two seemingly butt heads at every turn, and Jaeha simply cannot figure out why. The answer is simple: Doyoung sees Jaeha’s coy, flirtatious teasing of Hyun as bullying, and wants to protect his new friend. Their wires crossed, an unending cycle of misunderstandings and misfortunes between the rivals ensues; however, a fateful game of basketball just might spark something electric between them…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

152037.description:
The dome of the heavens expands without limits in a sea of clouds. The hearts of men are forever drawn upward. The way of the heavens is unfathomable, and men cannot even hope to grasp it. Who in the world never thought of living forever? Star crossed lovers torn between the struggles of the righteous and demon paths. A man and an ancient sword. How is he going to face the world?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

152038.description:
“Can a human trust another human? To trust is to gamble. Then where should I bet?” The notorious mafia “Sambuca” abducts children and produces drugs. To fight against them, Mi-Ho Won, the heir of one of the wealthiest families in Korea, recruits immortal girl Suk-Ui Kang and former mafia member Lilia to form “The QUEENS.” Will The QUEENS be able to win the war against Sambuca?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

152039.description:
The late Joseon period, when culture and art flourished brilliantly. Behind the king's reforms stood a man who protected the king with a single sword. And there was a boy who wanted to protect that man. Heo Min-Jun, the man who had to live by the king's sword. Yoon Se-Ha, the boy who loved him. The poignant chronicle of their love.

“I cherish you.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

152040.description:
When a world-weary bartender saves a wooden cat doll from the rain one fateful night, he gets more than he ever bargained for... The cat talks and serves a little boy with lavender hair and monstrously sharp teeth. Say hello to Vry.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue, epilogue, and 12 extra chapters.

152041.description:
Jun-Yeong, whose life was thrown into turmoil after losing his job due to the Bitcoin crash, barely manages to survive by becoming a chauffeur for his wealthy friend Ji-Ho. However, a chance encounter with his friend's wife, Ha-Na, sparks a sinister desire...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

152042.description:
He makes my heart beat like crazy... It feels like it's about to burst!!! Wait... Was he just acting...?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

152043.description:
“I missed you!” The tale of a dog who came back as a human!

(Source: Copin Comics)

152044.description:
When a sudden fire forces Jae-Gyoung out of his shared living quarters, he's left scrambling for a place to stay-- all while struggling to stay afloat. Just as things seem to take a turn for the worse, Seong-Beom, a college classmate of Jae-Gyeong's, surprises him with a streak of generosity. He offers Jae-Gyeong a spare room in his apartment-- free of charge. But the two couldn't be more different, Jae-Gyeong is reserved, while Seong-Beom's outgoing nature seems to fill every room he enters. As they navigate the challenges of sharing a home, and a budding friendship, their clashing personalities ignite tension, possibly warming up to something more. Will their spark turn into a roaring flame or die out into embers?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 side story chapters.
synonyms: 陽キャのコミュ力で、仏頂面男子を懐柔したい。

152045.description:
“Are you prepared to handle what I’m about to do to you?”

For Choi Bom, running into Kang Doha for the first time seven years causes him great emotional unrest. On the one hand, he’s glad that Doha is safe and sound, but on the other, he’s angry. Angry at Doha for disappearing for so long, and angry at himself for still caring. So when Doha says he wants to apply for the position as Bom’s housekeeper, Bom wonders if this might be the perfect chance to sort through his tumultuous emotions. Except, Doha refuses to answer any personal questions, leaving Bom more confused than ever. Just why did Doha disappear, and what is it that’s brought him back? Any most importantly, how can Bom be sure that Doha will stay?

(Source: Lezhin US)

152047.description:
1. Mahou Jika Hatsuden (魔法自家発電)
2. Sofabed Tour (ソファベッド・ツアー)
3. Who nu Tsukeru Namae (Ｗｈｏにつける名前)
4. Otenki Hanbai (おてんきはんばい)
5. Futari Jikan (２人時間)
synonyms: ソファベッド・ツアー

152048.description:
A maid swaps lives with a lady...

Set in the Japanese colonial period, a young girl is gifted a maidservant who looks just like her on her 8th birthday. The fate of the two children entwines as they each carve out their own destiny, surpassing obstacles such as status and gender, education and culture, and ethnicity and race.

(Source: Manta)

152052.description:
Trying new things is never easy.

O-Ran Im is an ex-boxer who never managed to go pro. Now, she spends her days working at the local convenience store, wondering where it all went wrong. But after she meets young couple Un and Ba-Ram, she slowly begins to change her outlook on life. "I need to find what makes me happy."

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.native: 世界の終わりには君と一緒に
title.romaji: Sekai no Owari ni wa Kimi to Issho ni

152054.description:
On an ordinary day, a rift suddenly opened in the sky and innumerable monsters came through the opening. Yi Tianhang relied on his spiritual sense to get him and his sister safely through the "Seven Days Of Disaster." After which thousands of other worlds appeared and merged with Earth to form a massive new planet, as the world moved into a new era — The Eternal Kingdom.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: なんしょんなら!! お義兄さん
バレエ・リュス ニジンスキーとディアギレフ

synonyms: Hwa Rang Kwan in San Francisco

152063.description:
Fukiko has never had a boyfriend, always being dedicated to her work. However, she is unexpectedly fired from her job because of a mistake made by an unreliable junior colleague...! Just when it seems like she has hit rock-bottom, one last great shining hope appears for Fukiko...?

A new age Cinderella story by Erika Sakurazawa!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 恋はお金じゃ買えません
勇者様!? こ…これってそういう意味ですか?!♥
title.romaji: Yuusha-sama!? Ko... Korette Souiu Imi desu ka?!♥

152065.description:
For a long time, mankind would summons a "hero" from another world once every 100 years to fight the Demon Lord's army. However, one day, the Demon Lord came up with a countermeasure against the heroes. The idea was to trap and kill the defenseless heroes immediately after the summoning. To commemorate this historic feat, the Great Demon Lord designated this year as "the first year of the trapped kill." Since then, all the heroes have been killed on spawn by the Demon Lord's army. In the 1,000th year of the trapped kill, the summoner was very worried. "What kind of brave man should I call? I don't know...someone make my worries go away!"

The summoned hero turned out to be Hiroyuki, the founder of 2chan and a master of argumentation...!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated) Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

title.native: ひろゆき、異世界でも論破で無双します
title.romaji: Hiroyuki, Isekai demo Ronpa de Musou Shimasu

title.native: ホントに久々のダビデ君
ジェノサイド・オンライン 極悪令嬢のプレイ日記
title.romaji: Genocide Online: Gokuaku Reijou no Play Nikki

152070.description: An anthology of love stories on the theme of eccentric love in another world, depicting forms of opposite-sex, same-sex, non-human, brokon, siskon, narcissistic and abnormal love.

title.native: Laurus（ラウルス）異世界偏愛コミックアンソロジー
南風原カーリングストーンズ

152073.description: At a school where children are raised by several "Fathers" and "Mothers" who aren't their biological parents, a boy named Sirius suddenly transfers in. Unlike the other children, he was raised by a single mother and father. A girl Enico is made responsible for his care and integration to the school. But meeting Sirius and learning about the world he was raised in makes Enico question her own...

152075.description:
Sanpei is a boy beekeeper and the sole survivor of an accident that killed his entire family. Sanpei meets Chiyo, a girl who gets stung by a bee, and starts a new life in her village. 

(Source: Anime News Network, abridged)

152076.description:
Chise Kashima got a job at a construction company through her grandmother who lives on the island. She thought she was going to have a wonderful work life at a resort, but... the construction site was full of scary people! What did she realize while working hard and sweating?

(Source: Shonen Jump+, translated)

title.native: 出陣!! ムショ高排球軍

152082.description:
50 years ago, a silk scroll that the tomb raiders from Changsha uncovered recorded the location of a unique tomb from the Warring States period. 50 years later, one of the tomb raiders’ grandson discovered this secret in his notes. He then assembled a party of experienced tomb raiders to go for a treasure hunt. But nobody had expected that so many strange things would happen in the ancient tomb. The Seven Stars Sarcophagus, the green-eyed corpse, the nine-headed snakes, and more. They discovered the owner of this mysterious tomb and found the real sarcophagus. This is a story filled with mysteries and a plot with twists and turns.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

152083.description:
By chance, Li Yunmu found a supercomputer from humanity’s dark ages. After that, his pathetic life would never be the same! Aptitude? Talent? Who needs those? I have neither aptitude nor talent, but my shadow can keep grinding experience for me in real life even when I'm away. XP, mana, weapon mastery……. all of them could be hacked, so I'm gaining experience even while I'm asleep.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

152084.description:
In the future, there were special people called "Energy Masters." They can manipulate the energy that exists in the natural world. Hiro Kazami is a boy who longs to become an "Energy Master." His great adventure begins now!

(Source: Saikyo Jump, translated)

152085.description:
"Please, don't tell anyone about this, and I'll do anything you say..."

After joining the campus broadcasting club, he learns the secret of the girl that he has a crush on!

(Source: TOPTOON+)
synonyms: 放送部以外、出入り禁止

152086.description:
Azalea, a duke’s daughter, was once known as the “Wicked Woman Who Ruined the Country” in her previous life and was executed on those false charges. All she wanted in her second life was to live peacefully without being involved in politics or power struggles… but for some reason, she was chosen to be Crown Prince Lotus’ fiancée.

Lotus is a problem child that even his parents, the king, and queen themselves, have no idea how to handle. Even though Azalea is being thrown into chaos by the eccentric actions of this extreme genius, gradually, she finds that she can’t leave the boy alone…

So begins a pure love story filled with nonstop gags and romance!
synonyms: The Former Homewrecker and Flag-Crushing Crown Prince: Even After I Reincarnated, I Still Can't Avoid the Execution Ending?!

title.native: 元・傾国の美女とフラグクラッシャー王太子 転生しても処刑エンドが回避できません!?
title.romaji: Moto Keikoku no Bijo to Flag Crusher Outaishi Tensei Shitemo Shokei End ga Kaihi Dekimasen!?

152087.description:
Azalea, a duke’s daughter, was once known as the “Wicked Woman Who Ruined the Country” in her previous life and was executed on those false charges. All she wanted in her second life was to live peacefully without being involved in politics or power struggles… but for some reason, she was chosen to be Crown Prince Lotus’ fiancée.

Lotus is a problem child that even his parents, the king, and queen themselves, have no idea how to handle. Even though Azalea is being thrown into chaos by the eccentric actions of this extreme genius, gradually, she finds that she can’t leave the boy alone…

So begins a pure love story filled with nonstop gags and romance!
synonyms: The Former Homewrecker and Flag-Crushing Crown Prince: Even After I Reincarnated, I Still Can't Avoid the Execution Ending?!

title.native: 元・傾国の美女とフラグクラッシャー王太子 転生しても処刑エンドが回避できません!?
title.romaji: Moto Keikoku no Bijo to Flag Crusher Outaishi Tensei Shitemo Shokei End ga Kaihi Dekimasen!?

152088.description:
Life in a war-torn empire isn’t easy for a girl. That’s why Kira was raised and educated by her mother as a boy. But when her mother passes away, Kira is left to make her own way in the world, and the older she gets, the harder it is to maintain a masculine appearance. So when a magical being appears one night promising to grant any wish in return for a favor, Kira asks to be given a male voice. Now with a stronger disguise, she accepts a job as a page to a nobleman – and not just any nobleman, but the grand duke! However, the job isn’t nearly as simple as she thought, and Kira will have to work hard and face many challenges ahead if she wants to succeed.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: La lampe de glace - Les chroniques de Kira
氷のランプ～キラのクロニクル～

title.english: Ice Lamp - The Chronicles of Kira

152089.description:
An outcast from the imperial family due to her freewheeling attitude and refusal to get married, Princess Melody Corbella wants nothing more than to live life on her own terms and protect the people of the empire. Using her secret powers to sneak out of the palace to influence affairs from behind the scenes, she ends up drawing the attention of the handsome imperial guard, Caisar Bethel. Though she avoided romance until now, could love finally bloom for this crazy flower?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Princess Blooms into a Crazy Flower
Princess Blooms as a Crazy Flower
La Princesa Florece Como Una Flor Loca
A Princesa Floresce como uma Flor Maluca
เจ้าหญิงคลั่งแห่งวังหลวง

152090.description:
In a world where humans were invaded by kaiju-like dragons, a boy meets with one that can take the form of a little girl.

Note: Winner of the 108th Weekly Shounen Magazine Rookie Manga Award.
synonyms: 家族を失った灯台守が竜を拾う話

152091.description:
Spin off of Eiga Daisuki Pompo-san focusing on the character Fran-chan.

Note: Began serialization in Gene Pixiv on July 27, 2018.
synonyms: 映画大好きフランちゃん NYALLYWOOD STUDIOS SERIES

title.native: 映画大好きフランちゃん

152092.description:
Sabani, since his childhood, films everything he sees with a camera tied to his shoulder. A true image hunter, he never misses an opportunity to capture intense moments, even if it means provoking them himself...

When he arrives in the town of Enoshima, determined to save a small dilapidated cinema from ruin, it is also to interfere, sometimes with humor, sometimes with gravity, in the daily life of the people of the region, and to push them to finally become actors of their own life.

152093.description:
“This is the Narcotics Control Department. Drop your weapons!”

This is Japan where narcotics were legalized. It is here that some drug addicts have attained supernatural powers thanks to the new drug called Icarus. Those addicts, called dopemen, became a threat to common people. And the special investigation unit, aka "D Unit," organized to crack down on them also consists of dopemen. Thus begins a superhuman doping battle!

(Source: Comikey)

synonyms: Star Children - Tama Mitsuboshi Short Stories

title.native: 星の子どもたち 三星たま短編集
title.romaji: Hoshi no Kodomo-tachi: Mitsuboshi Tama Tanpenshuu

152096.description:
Ichika is a high school girl who was the lead for an underground girl band, but one day she was suddenly forced out of the group. Nirai is a high school boy who has donated 377800-yen to a VTuber idol, only to be driven to despair over being treated like an ATM.

With this terrible history, both of them at their very bottom, what will happen when these two meet?
synonyms: Our Circumstances At the Bottom of the Hierarchy

152097.description:
When Ara is invited to have a threesome by the alluring Yoojin, she doesn’t expect her old high school friend Seungmin to show up as their third member. They’ve shared many things with each other back in the day, including discussions about sex, but they’ve never shared their bodies before. Tonight, though, everything is going to change. The question is: will it just be their bodies they share, or will there be something more?

(Source: Lezhin X)

152098.description:
After a humiliating breakup, Kibum suffers from recurring nightmares of his cheating ex. But a new school year always comes with the added anticipation of romance, and Kibum is more than determined to spice up his love life once again!

(Source: Lezhin X)

152099.description:
After three years of struggling to find a job, Kim Donghyuk manages to get hired at the esteemed company, DN group. Not only is it one of the most highly respected corporations in Korea, but it’s famous for having a plethora of sexy woman in its workforce. This is everything Donghyuk has ever dreamed of… except for just one thing. His boss, aka “the ruffian”, whose nickname stems from the brutal way she treats her subordinates, turns out to be his ruthless high school bully. Will Donghyuk be able to navigate the murky waters of his new office environment?

(Source: Lezhin X)
synonyms: 社内恋愛〜カリスマ上司は元いじめっ子!?〜

152100.description:
College student Jung-hyuk just finished his military service and is ready to find a part-time job to pay for his expenses. To celebrate their discharge, he and his best friend Yong-il go clubbing together. Be it a coincidence or not, they meet Jia, Jung-hyuk’s unforgettable first love, and her sexy friend Soojung. Contrary to his wishes, but still unable to refuse, Jung-hyuk ends up having a one night stand with Soojung. As if his life wasn’t already complicated enough, now he keeps running into Soojung and Jia all the time, and he just can’t seem to refuse Soojung’s advances. He is torn since his body wants one thing, but his heart wants another. Add his best friend, his best friend’s little sister and his newly found boss to the mix and things are sure to get even more complicated. Love triangles, steamy nights and unrequited loves. Who’ll be flying high in the end?

(Source: Lezhin X)
synonyms: Flying High：フライング・ハイ

152101.description:
A multi-volume one-shot series. These well-honed fairy tales are a bit mysterious and make you want to read them over and over again.

Volume 1 (released January 7, 2022):

2. Hana Guerrilla (花ゲリラ, The Flower Guerrilla); Flowers 6/21
3. Ai no Ue, Ao no Shita (藍の上青の下); Flowers 9/21
4. Hoshi Hiroi (星拾い, Star Gleaners); Flowers 12/21

Volume 2 (released January 10, 2023):

6. Hanayome (花嫁, The Plant Bride); Flowers 6/22
7. Zurari Naranda (ずらりならんだ); Flowers 9/22
8. Korogaru Kagami (転がる鏡, The Rolling Mirror); Flowers 12/22

Volume 3 (released December 8, 2023);
9. Akuta Cross (あくた・クロス); Flowers 3/23
10. Hiso Hiso Lace (ひそひそレース, The Whispers of Laces); Flowers 6/23

Ai no Ue, Ao no Shita (藍の上青の下)

152102.description: A Gyeolsa is one who fight monsters with their divine powers. In this world, Eunha Seong was admitted to Hyeolseong, the school for training gyeolsa, yet for some reason not all of the eyes on him seem to be too welcoming...? Will Eunha really be able to graduate from Hyeolseong in one piece to become a gyeolsa?

152104.description:
Baek Woo-Jin is the youngest son of a renowned swordsman family who has neither talent in swordsmanship nor an impressive Aura, despite trying harder than anyone. Although he was dishonored by his own family and killed, he reincarnates as the owner of a Magic Sword. His only goal is the destruction of his own family.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I Became a Renowned Family's Sword Prodigy
偉大なる家門の天才剣士になった

152105.description:
An 18-year-old university student Takanori and 17-year-old high schooler Hikaru become brother and sister when their parents get married. Just when their happy family life is about to start, their parents' plane crash on their honeymoon! Despite this, Takanori and Hikaru continue to live together. However, everything changes as they learn about the billion yen insurance money their parents left for them! An adventure full of comedy and romance is about to begin!

(Source: Media Do International)

152106.description:
"The head of the Chiyogami family conglomerate, Sou Chiyogami. And the woman who was their slave, Rindo Amadera. In a twisted and cruel world, these two each became monsters (sadists). Years later they meet again, yet this time their roles are reversed. Sadist versus sadist...a distorted lover game is about to begin..."

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.native: サディスティック・ラヴァーゲーム

152107.description:
Sometimes all it takes is a little push from fate to find your true happiness... "A Substitute Marriage With an Admirable Husband": Miya has an older sister, Mirei. Mirei is elegant, proper, and polite, the family's jewel. Miya, however, is none of that. She is scolded for being childish, wearing old kimonos, and having no manners. But even she admires her older sister, especially because Mirei will marry Kenichiro Hirose, Miya's first and lifelong love. As the days lead up to the big wedding, Mirei is nowhere to be found. This marriage is impossible without the bride! To everyone's surprise, Miya takes her chance and volunteers to marry Kenichiro in her sister's stead. Will this be the happily ever after she always wanted? "Smile, Again": It wasn't her fault. This mistake was not Ayako's fault. And yet, here she is again, apologizing for a mistake that. Wasn't. Her. Fault. Ayako is like that. She is bullied for speaking slowly and being timid until she is pushed to quit her job. Ayako hates being like that. So when she meets dazzling and charming Hal while on a trip to Europe, Ayako grows a whole new shell. Maybe there are more ways Hal can bring a fresh breeze into Ayako's life...

(Source: Manga Planet)

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

title.english: A Substitute Marriage With an Admirable Husband

152111.description:
Tomomi, a graduate student in the philosophy department, had a crush on Professor Takatsuki, who was famous for being a strict disciplinarian as a teacher. After a drinking party, Takatsuki saved her from being taken away by a male student, but the drunk Tomomi thought that the professor treating her so kindly was all just a dream. When she woke up the next morning, she found herself in Takatsuki's bed. As Tomomi worried about her future in the department, Takatsuki made a proposal to her: "Why don't you marry me?"

(Source: eBookJapan, translated)

152114.description:
As the leader of a debt collecting company, An Yamo threatens people and acts cute. When she acts pitiful, nobody can resist her. Once she takes action, there is no debt she cannot collect. But one day, she meets a tough opponent. Since phone calls don't work, she brings her men to knock on his door, only to discover that he is a super handsome boy who is actually her schoolmate! Handsome boy: "If you don't want to be exposed, become my slave~" Thus, the school life of the tyrannical girl and the sadistic prince, which is full of battles and clashes, begins.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

152115.description:
Ms. Otsbell has known as a remarkable woman with a smart head and aggressive hands. One day, a working elephant comes to her place wanted to find a job, a moment that would change the fate of Otsbell and the factory forever. "Otsbell and the Elephant" is adapted from the famous play by Kenji Miyazawa with a new interpretation...

(Source: Manga Club)

Note: Winner of the 11th Monthly COMIC Ryujin Award.

One day she meets Miyatake, a friend of her brother and her first impression is not at all positive and on the contrary, she is annoyed by the boy; however, every time she has a problem Miyatake appears and stands by her. Will his sweetness be able to reach her?

A horror anthology by Miyako Cojima that is sometimes kooky, sometimes gory, and sometimes positively profound!

152121.description: A oneshot that ran in the May 2016 issue of Harta. It's a story based on the Scandinavian legend of St. Lucia.

title.romaji: Haru no Yoi, Hisoka no Mori

152123.description:
Since the surprise conjoining of their families seven years ago, Yukio has grown to love and care for his new, bigger, louder family. For a while, things were peaceful... until Masumi's cousin Ringo comes back to follow through on his declaration of love made seven years ago: he is going to marry Big Bro Yukio. Just when Masumi is content with how he and Yukio have grown close, his cousin/rival appears and threatens his ease. But what Masumi should have been worrying about wasn't Ringo at all...

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: My Younger Stepbrother Can't Keep His Hands Off Me! -The Too Much Love Arc-
title.native: セクハラブラザーズ 愛されすぎ編

152124.description:
Secret Flight Part 1, Secret Flight Part 2, Secret Flight Extra Story
Shiyoh and Sawano are called upon for a special PR trip to Hanashima Island as the representative pilot and flight assistant of Japan Oriental Airlines (JLA). A lovely little getaway for the secret lovers. But what will diffident Yuzuru do when disaster strikes and Shiyoh is in danger!?

Rhapsodic
When a famous Korean actor asks for his flight attendant Aki to show him around, Aki may have been too early to assume that he meant around the city...

Captain Shiyoh's Secret?
Even Yuzuru didn't know...

Mens' Club
In an intense competition of strip-rock-paper-scissors, who will win the coveted trip to Hawaii?

Love and Hate
Oogaki has always wanted to see his half-brother writhe at his own hands' doing. Maybe today he gets that chance... (Warning: Rape, Incest)

Taste Testing
Takahata has just moved to Tokyo, where he believes his dream of finding another man to sleep with will come true... (Warning: Gang rape)

Blond Lover
Yuri Saga is sure he is being called into the office to be fired. But what he finds on the other side of the door is... the CEO's handsome grandson from Spain!? (Warning: Dubious consent)

Someone Like You
The time has come for Natsume to start his first day at his dream job at Taylor Akasaka. Let's hope the owner himself doesn't fire him upon the first blab!

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ロマンチックフライト

152125.description:
Fantasize no longer! The creator of Momo and Manji Sawa Sakura has answered our wishes with Momo and Manji's Modern Day Parody. Follow a day in the life of glasses-wearing, former-firefighter now-data analyst Manji, and retired child model turned nursery school teacher Momoki, in Reiwa times. That means that Momo and Manji interacting with video calls, online shopping (on a tablet!), e-cigarettes, and more modern developments! But it doesn't stop there! Momo and Manji's Modern Day Parody includes your other favorite characters from Momo and Manji, reimagined as modern people, too! Plus, a "Fantasy Conversation Corner" between the editor, Sawa Sakura's friend and a member of staff, and Sawa Sakura the creator!

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Originally released as a bonus booklet bundled with the Toranoana edition of Momo to Manji Volume 4.
synonyms: 百と卍 公式同人誌

152126.description:
1. Ame Otoko (雨男)
2. Shiseru Oujo no Tame no Pavane (死せる王女のための孔雀舞（パヴァーヌ))
3. Saraba Madonna no Hohoemi (さらばマドンナの微笑)
4. Ware wa Sono Na mo Shirazariki (我はその名も知らざりき)
5. Yumekui (夢喰い)

title.native: 死せる王女のための孔雀舞
title.romaji: Shiseru Joou no Tame no Pavane

152127.description:
Yumeko Nozaki is a maiden high school girl. She's greeted by the transfer student Ritsuo Miyoshi and makes him go along with her shoujo manga cliches, much to his annoyance...

This is about the daily life of Nozaki-san, who longs for a shoujo manga world yet hasn't noticed that her own brother is a popular shoujo manga artist -- a comedy about a girl with a shoujo manga brain!!

This is a spin-off of Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun and takes place three years after the main timeline. Based on the the author's original idea to have Umetarou Nozaki's younger sister Yumeko as the protagonist of the original story.

152128.description:
Wouldn’t it be a dream to wake up in a world of your own creation? For Kim Hajin, it’s nothing short of a nightmare. With no clue how or why he’s been transported into his web novel — as a mere extra, no less! — Hajin has little choice but to see his story through until the end. Lucky for him, as the author, he knows this perilous world like the back of his hand. But when discrepancies in the plot begin popping up left and right, Hajin soon realizes that things aren’t quite so simple, after all…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 小説の中のエキストラ
ผมก็แค่ตัวประกอบในนิยาย
成為我筆下小說的路人甲

152129.description: Special one-shot set shortly after the end of the main story.
synonyms: Dr. STONE テラフォーミング

152130.description:
Written as the villainess, Ilyana Glayne finds a noble boy named Magnus and tames him, causing him to lose his identity and become her submissive “beast.” While reading this story, a fan emails the author to inquire about the plot. When she wakes up the next morning, she finds she has become Ilyana herself! Disgusted by Ilyana’s actions, she vows to free Magnus from his beastly existence. But when Magnus steals a kiss from her, Ilyana realizes she may have changed the plot more than she wanted!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.
synonyms: The Beast Tamed by the Villainess
The Beast Tamed by the Evil Woman
พันธนาการรักนางมารร้าย
La bête apprivoisée par la Vilaine

152131.description:
After two rebirths and two miserable, failed marriages, Leah Riveron vowed to never wed again. Despite this, she can’t get one man, the handsome duke Julian Raenal, off her mind. Though he ignored her in the past, this time, Leah throws caution to the wind and tells him every detail of her past lives. He won’t be interested anyway, right? But rather than repelling him, her refreshing honesty ends up charming him! Now, with Julian hooked, will Leah’s plan of a marriage-free life go as planned?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ลูกพีชเดือนมิถุนายน

title.native: 少年と私の事情アンソロジー
title.romaji: Shounen to Watashi no Jijou Anthology

title.native: 黄昏のニキータちゃん

152139.description:
Snow Xia, a pretty girl who’s positive towards life and always emits her sunshine to people around her. But she never imagined in all her life that at her wedding today, she caught her husband cheating on her! Being in extreme despair, she wanted to kill herself but one moment before her drowning, she wished if someone could save her, and she closed her eyes… "Who are you? Why are you naked and l am also…ahhh!” and she saw him, the man with a pair of devilish eyes sneering at her.

(Source: MangaToon)

152140.description:
"Blood and Heart: The Legendary Life of Japanese PLA Soldier Megumi Sahara" is a comic biography that tells the legendary life of Japanese Soldier Megumi Sahara, showing the true history of this little-known special group of the Japanese PLA.

Sahara Megumi was born in the Kyushu region of Japan in 1933 and came to Northeast China with his parents when he was a child. After Japan was defeated and surrendered, because he could not return to Japan, he lived in a landlord's house in Liaoning to graze cattle. In 1948, Sha Yuanhui joined the People's Liberation Army in the name of "Zhang Rongqing". Since then, he has experienced the battles of Liaoshen and Pingjin, and participated in the Korean War...

152141.description:
Within the austere confines of a grand house, the beguiling story of a troubled boy, his disengaged sister, and their perpetually infirm mother begins to unfold...

Serialised in GARO 1993-06

title.native: 聖線上 の アリア

152142.description:
Long before the universe came into existence, a magical object appeared out of chaos. No one knows how many years has passed, and now it actually split into 18 pieces. Each piece of it contains some overwhelming power that eventually metamorphoses into an immortal being. By chance, Yun Changkong obtained the tripod of the God of war. So begins his wonderful journey to the supreme.

(Source: Mangatoon)

152143.description:
In the era of Tenmei's Great Famine, plagued by crop failures, desperate farmers sold their daughters to human traffickers, and those suffering from hunger were said to have resorted to cannibalism. It was a dark time. In the midst of this, there was a wandering swordsman who called himself the "Funeral Soldier", burying the past and flowing with the present.

During his journey, this Funeral Soldier, named Okasa Haminosuke, saved a woman who had been swept away by the Setagawa River near Ise. Through this encounter, he met a woman named Okimi and a female merchant named Genshi. Genshi would sell Okimi to a brothel, receive payment, and then help her escape, only to repeat the process with another brothel, earning money along the way. At first glance, it seemed like a simple relationship between a female merchant and a woman being sold, but their lives were intertwined with the horrifying reality of famine, a tale they couldn't share with anyone else.

synonyms: My Hentai Artist Childhood Friend is Troubling Me

title.native: 幼馴染のエロ絵師ちゃんに困らされてる話
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Ero Eshi-chan ni Komara Sareteru Hanashi

152145.description:
Tanimoto, who is madly obsessed with fashion and style, finally meets his idol, SEN. However, it turns out SEN is actually his classmate, Yamanaka, dressed as a girl.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
152145.hashtag: #ポーカーフェイス女装男子と

今日もお天気　入学入園編

今日もお天気　猫がともだち編
今日もお天気　小学校卒業編
今日もお天気　家族でパリ旅行編

152150.description:
In a magical academy for summoners, students combine impressive stores of magical energy with artful incantations to usher legends, great and small, onto the battlefield. Feil Fonaf, an eighteen-year-old farmer's son, may have had a rougher upbringing than his more affluent peers, but he's here to prove he deserves his spot at the academy as much as anyone else! And as luck would have it, his counterpart summon winds up being the legendary god-slaying beast, Pandora! ...There's just one problem.

(Source: Yen Press)

152151.description: A young man is working with his grandfather as fisherman. One day a mysterious creature coming from the sea itself who looks just like the young man.
synonyms: The Man Who Came In from the Sea

title.native: 海の向こうからきた男
title.romaji: Umi no Mukou Kara Kita Otoko

152152.description:
Exposing his gigantic dick by accident in campus, Nam-Hyeon is too embarrassed and is thinking of taking a break from school. But what the teaching assistant Han-Yeong, said might be right. He keeps somehow getting linked to the popular girls.

"Hey, they all want a taste of it~!"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

152153.description: The story follows a former yakuza turned mangaka.

title.native: チリアクタ ーTHE AFTER YAKUZA STORYー
title.romaji: Chiri Akuta: The After Yakuza Story

152154.description: A gag manga with a lot of radical content such as violence and off-color humor.

synonyms: The Devil in Your Subconscious: The Real You

152158.description:
1. The Princess Will Someday... by Amane Ruri
2. I Think I Might Love Her by Suto
3. My First Time with Onee-chan. by Amedamacon
4. The Solution to Sexlessness! by Suzuki Senpai
5. Sister Room at Night by Soso-Zagri
6. Background Girl vs Spotlight Girl by Homura Subaru

152159.description:
Ma Hyeon-A, who shows off her luxury brand on SNS, says she is a wealthy girl but in reality she lives in a shabby apartment infested with cockroaches. She meets Ji-Yeong, who is being bullied at a transfer school following her father who is changing jobs, and Hyeon-A gives her a little kindness. Then, Ji-Yeong accidentally finds out her own reality, not her fake appearance on SNS. Ji-Yeong wants Hyeon-A to be her best friend as she keeps the secret. Is Ji-Yeong a good best friend or an object of fear of excessive obsession?

(Source: Naver, translated)

152160.description:
After her "storm kick" video goes viral on the Internet, Baek-hui is too humiliated and ashamed to live in Korea and wants to relocate to a different country. To do so, she agrees to marry Han-Gyeol, who holds a permanent resident status in Australia, and plans to divorce him as soon as she gets her visa. However, to receive their marriage certificate, they must prove that their love is "legit." How are they going to do that when their marriage is a fraud?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

152161.description:
My name is Rosaria von Valencia, but I didn't always have this name. According to a book I read, I'm supposed to be murdered in place of the saint, Cordelia, just because I look like her. I decided to run away to avoid ever meeting my future killer, Duke Valencia, but ended up running into him as he was on the brink of death. After I saved him in the hopes of being spared, he adopted me as his daughter! Now that my new dad's spoiling me with love, does this mean I'll get to live until the end?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: บุตรสาวผู้ล้ำค่าของวายร้าย

152162.description:
Choi Ah-ran, a novelist and publisher, runs a publishing company while hiding the humiliation of her past as Jo Ah-han, a writer who made a big name for herself 20 years ago with an internet novel about the most popular student of Sanggo High falling for an ordinary high school student. Ah-ran goes to her parents' house, where she grew up, to announce the end of her engagement, but loses consciousness and is dragged into the realm of internet novels, Cheonyang. Cheonyang is completely different from reality. Her now divorced parents affectionately wake up Ah-ran, and emoticons expressing their feelings appear in the speech balloon. The spelling is a mess! Such a cliché blabber! Ah-ran goes to school in an unguarded moment and realizes that this is an imaginary world where the laws of internet fiction are constantly occurring. "This is a world I made up, so I can escape!" While searching for a way to go back home, she goes to the city with her friend Soyoung, and meets the Four Heavenly Kings in the arcade. Ah-ran falls off the stairs and lands on Kang Hwiyoung, their leader. "Oh, no! If I fall like that, there is a high probability that I will kiss Hwiyoung regardless of my falling position!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Time When We Were Young
At That Time We Were Young

152163.description:
Empress Olivia knows happiness is the last thing she deserves, but when she finally becomes pregnant with the emperor’s child, she thinks things might finally be taking a turn for the better. Alas, Olivia realizes how naive she was when her husband poisons her tea, killing both her and their unborn child. When Olivia opens her eyes again in the body of an unknown woman in the slums, she vows to take vengeance against the emperor. To do so, she forms a marriage alliance with her former fiancé, Duke Lucas Viterpan, the true heir to the empire who was deposed in a coup. Will this man and woman who had everything taken from them succeed in getting revenge?

(Source: Tappytoon)

152165.description:
Hananoki Ume is an extremely energetic eighth grader. One day, using a scroll given to her by her auntie, she transformed into a ninja wielding "suppa" powers! She will show you how to make your love bloom with her splendid ninjutsu.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: リリカル忍伝すっぱだもん!

152166.description:
"Life is a shitty game," said Kagurazaka Tsubaki, a gamer who is also a recluse and a NEET, going through the motions of his depraved daily life. For Tanabata, he went to sleep wishing he could live in the game world instead, but... When he woke up, he found the extremely beautiful demon lord "Gücklich Kite" looking him. This is the world of the game Tsubaki used to play! Kite pushed Tsubaki down, saying, "You will be the mother of this country by mating with me, the Demon Lord." Is he about to be taken by the handsome Demon Lord? The forbidden child-bearing mission between a beautiful demon lord and a reclusive gamer is about start!

(Source: Animage Comics Haruto, translated)

The Devil Is Dad and I'm Mom

title.native: おもらし好きだけど○○だ。

152171.description:
With his dreams broken food deliveryman Riku has hit reset on all his personal relations. While feeling nothing but frustration at everything around him, his one relief is the odd gal Kirari who works at an equally odd convenience store.

But Kirari's cheery and flashy personality is merely one side of herself. When she decides to reveal her private self to Riku who unknowingly lives in the same building as her Kirari triggers a chain of events that one by one brings her closer to all the residents of her building. All with their own pasts, dreams, and loneliness.

title.native: エンプレスエイジ～闇社会の主役は我々だ！～
title.romaji: Empress Age: Yami Shakai no Shuyaku wa Wareware da!

152173.description:
Kyoko Okamura, age 30. Keeeeeeeeeeeee!

What happens when a girl who was raised by poisonous parents or a child who was abandoned become adults? Five selections of traumatic manga stories that convey Ryoko Yamagishi's genius.

In "Tennin Karakusa," a young girl raised by an anachronistically strict father grows up with mixed emotions, overly wary of others.
In "Harpy," a female-faced bird-monster from Greek mythology appears as a beautiful girl before the eyes of a boy living an ordinary high school life.
In "Kitsunejo," a boy born to a concubine is taken in by the family of his deceased father and searches for his "real mother."
"Kago no Naka no Tori" tells the story of a boy of "bird-man" blood, who has the special ability to hear the words of the dead, and a folklorist named Hitomi, whose love for him transcends the love of her own flesh and blood. Sumio heads to H-city during a heat wave to take care of the animal at his grandfather's house while he's away on an overseas trip. "Natsu no Guuwa" describes his mysterious experience with a girl he meets in a park.

Yamagishi's world is so sad, painful, and poignant that you will surely be struck by her genius and the depth of her world!

(Source: Bunshun, translated)

Collected Stories:
1. Tenin Karakusa (天人唐草)
2. Harpy (ハーピー)
3. Kitsunejo (狐女)
4. Kago no Naka no Tori (籠の中の鳥)

152174.description:
Jean-Paul Nishi, Japanese author, tells us about his meeting with his future wife Karen, a French woman.

With a lot of humor and self-mockery, he depicts the life of a couple, their marriage, their pregnancy, the birth of the baby and the anecdotes of the months spent taking care of the baby at home, while his wife goes to work.

It is also an opportunity for him to talk about all the little cultural differences and French social norms that surprise or even confuse our Japanese friends.

(Source: Kana, translated)

title.native: モンプチ 嫁はフランス人

152175.description: Noriko Yahagi, a transfer student with outstanding motor skills, was invited to join the volleyball team at Matsuka High School by the captain of the club. She decided to join the club to attract the attention of Minato-kun, a member of the men's volleyball team who she loved at first sight.

152178.description:
Get to know the operators on Rhodes Island with Amiya and the Doctor.

(Source: Hypergryph, translated)

152183.description:
Kengo Kai is a guy who loves to use his binoculars to spy on a woman's apartment at night, when she masturbates uncontrollably. One day, when he was on his way to his part-time job, he noticed that a woman seemed to be having trouble in the bike parking. What puzzled him was that this woman is the one he always spies on at night. Thanks to the fact that he helped her, it would be how it would start the adventure of the two of them.

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-117) was released on April 4th, 2023.

152185.description:
A young man named Dick lives a peaceful life on the frontier with his father, as well as his sister, Anna.
Dick wants nothing more than to be able to buy a Gun Driver, which are large mech suits piloted by gunslingers. However, despite saving up enough money, when he goes to buy one he is turned away due to racial prejudices. Upon returning home, his world is turned upside down when he comes face-to-face with a gang of Gun Driver pilots called "The Wild Bunch", who attack his home and leave him without the use of his left arm. However, his life is saved when his father's left arm is transplanted onto him, allowing him to press onward. He then joins a mobile brothel called the "Jewel Palace", who will aid him on his quest for vengeance, and in rescuing his sister Anna.

title.native: 帰ってきた帰らないおじさん

152188.description:
Kang Yo-Han rises to fame as the first judge to preside a nationally broadcasted trial. With his decisive judgement and good looks, he is lauded a hero to bring much-needed change in the Korean justice system. However, his junior judge, Kim Ga-On, finds something amiss about Yo-Han... Whose sociopathic tendencies suggest he may be not entirely what he seems... Is Kang Yo-Han a truly heroic judge as the people think? Or is he just a devil in disguise?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

152190.description:
Ten years have passed since the story of "Kyoufu Shinbun." This time, the "Newspaper of Terror" was delivered to Yuko Hondo. Yuko and a mysterious boy, Tagaki, try to fight against its prophesy, but they failed and both ended up dying. Will the terror never end? Tonight, too, a "Newspaper of Terror" will be delivered to someone. But Miyabi Kokonoe, sent from the spirit world, will try to take on the evil spirits behind it.

(Source: Wikipedia Japan, translated)

152191.description:
Chisato and Reiko have been childhood friends for 15 years. They have different hobbies and personalities, but they have fallen in love with the same boy ― Keisuke Sugimoto, a member of the same music club as Chisato. When Keisuke confessed his feelings for Chisato, she was more concerned for Reiko―.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

2. Ano Natsu (あの夏)
3. Garasu no Houseki (ガラスの宝石)
4. Yuki no Hi Kara Hajimaru (雪の日からはじまる)

152192.description: An innocent woman is injured during a sabotage operation at a research institute. On the brink of death, she is somehow healed when cells of unknown origin that were being studied there hijack her body. The life-form christened "Algernon," slowly acclimates to human life. And what it wishes for is to live a peaceful life, like that of any other human being.

152195.description:
Hana's lifelong dream is to become a tailor and make wonderful clothes for people of all the different fantasy races. However, in a world where humans are discriminated against, even getting work as a seamstress is a struggle. When a handsome, mysterious prince offers her a job, it seems like Hana's fortunes might finally be changing for the better!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Junji Ito meets Mary Shelley! The master of horror manga bends all his skill into bringing the anguished and solitary monster—and the fouler beast who created him—to life with the brilliantly detailed chiaroscuro he is known for.

(Source: VIZ media)

"My sensitive body is putty in my nephew's teasing hands... So begins a tale of lust and immorality for the whole family.

A story about a man who got lost in the mountains on his way to attend his grandfather's funeral. He is saved by a beautiful and mysterious woman who finds him passed out.

152203.description:
Haukatul, a wizard who only talks, and Beni, an innocent girl.The two meet in a world overrun by wizards who kill for blood.

Haukatul, who is always hungry, and Beni, who has nothing but her name, set out on a journey with no destination.
But it is a world full of cruelty and love...

(Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

152205.description: How obscene... At school I am said to be 'straight-laced' and 'not interested in obscene topics' but...every night at home I play with myself to the infirmary nurse Shiraha-sensei. Just today I had a delusion of him extending his hand under the table while saying 'you sure love being teased' while teasing my sensitive spot...which I came to... Pervert... I'm such a pervert!!!

"A man collapsed in front of my house. I just wanted to help him out...... To think that my body would get so hot like this!!" The man Emi saves turns out to be a salesman for adult toys! He's cute, but persistent, and he gives Emi erotic yet heart-warming lessons in adult play. Emi, though, has some tricks up her sleeve, too (lol). Here you have a very sweet yet totally erotic love story!

(Source: Renta!)

152208.description:
No Yeong-ung joined the the new expansion team Knights after a tryout. His dream of becoming a professional baseball player was coming true. However, what awaited him was the cold reality of limited playing time. As he changed positions and sat on the bench, his skills deteriorated compared to his student days. His fellow players are better and sharper, the star manager only cares about himself…

Stuck in a situation where it feels like insurmountable obstacles are blocking his way, will No Yeong-ung be able to survive and become a star?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

152209.description:
Be careful what you wish for. Yu Haneul learns this the hard way when she makes a new year’s wish for her next love to be her last after being sick of all her failed marriage blind dates. This earns her the ability to see a magic number on people’s bodies, with “1” engraved on her own. She soon figures out that the number has something to do with how many relationships a person has left in their life. In other words, Haneul truly only has one remaining chance at love, just as she wished. That’s when she meets Jeon Haelim, who seems like the perfect guy except for two things. Not only is Haelim a much younger college student, but his number happens to be “99”...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: 1 เดียวที่ปรารถนา

152210.description:
What would you do if your neighbor didn’t stop making noise? People think of Si-U Seo as a nice guy, but when his upstairs neighbor refuses to stop making noise, he gradually becomes consumed by his desire for revenge despite the fact that his neighbor is dangerous. Si-U will stop at nothing to ruin his neighbor’s life, even if it means burning his own life to the ground.

(Source: WEBTOON)

152214.description:
The empire's archduchess Rosalin has a mysterious new lover, Fenrir, a lowborn shape-shifting anthromorph. However, in a world that separates them by class, their love didn’t bloom easily. Turning a blind eye to the injustices of the empire, Rosalin showed no interest in anyone but herself, and having never known his parents or even his own name, Fenrir trusted no one. In a society full of prejudice and hate for their love, can this unlikely couple overcome the odds against them?

(Source: Tapas)

152215.description:
In a world where the remnants of civilization depend on the Awakened, humans with special powers, to fend off otherworldly monsters, Kim Sunwoo is forced to survive as a mere guide for the Awakened. Just when he thinks his nightmarish days will never end, he's given a mission to protect one of the few remaining safe cities in exchange for a better life. It is then that a strange voice echoes in his head, and he discovers a power that could change the course of the war against monsters forever.

(Source: Tapas)

152216.description:
My kind boyfriend turns into a ravenous monster when he’s jealous? And so starts our messy bed of love…?!

Hina, who works as an attendant at a long-established Japanese Inn and has been dating its young master, Taichi, for 3 years. However, during those years they have never had sex, and while Taichi treats her with much care, Hina feels insecure as he has only rejected her advances in bed.

After Hina is reunited with her childhood friend, Haruma, Taichi reminds her how much he loves her through her body, by…

152217.description:
Taken higher so many times with the gentle, prince-like man, without even getting on the bed!

After a friend asks her to go on a questionable date in her place, Ran Yoshizaki hesitantly decides to go in order to help her father pay back his loan.
However, she was given an aphrodisiac without her knowledge and is about to be taken to the hotel!
Just when her chastity is in danger, it's none other than a regular at her part-time job and a person she looks up to, writer Haruyoshi Mikami, that saves her!
With an uncontrollable heat overflowing from within her, Haruyoshi gently whispers into Ran's ears and reaches deep inside her. What will happen next?

(Source: Renta!)

But even so, Yurika still believes her late mother's words, "You'll find the love of your life", and the man who appears before her is Muro, a mature man with both warm eyes and an indifferent attitude. An escapist love story about being attracted to a dangerous man!

"I can take care of it for you. For your first time." A love story between a cocky hotel heir and a poor humble OL!

Aoi Shima is a serious office-lady who works hard every day to help pay off her father's debt of 10-million yen. When she met Yukimura Shiki, a flirtatious, rich college student eight years her junior, he told her, "If you want my money, you'll have to bow and sit like a dog. So get on with it!" As Shiki waved his credit card in Aoi's face, what will she do…?

(Source: Live Comics, translated)
