Lunois Styler, an S-rank adventurer known as the "second sword saint," reunites with his childhood friend, Aine, who has fallen into slavery. Lunois buys Aine to save her, but she is fitted with a cursed collar that causes the wearer to "go into heat" once a day? Lunois' fight to find a way to remove the collar begins now!

(Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)
synonyms: My childhood friend who I used to train swordsmanship with became a slave, so I, as an S-Rank adventurer decided to buy her and protect her.

title.native: 一緒に剣の修行をした幼馴染が奴隷になっていたので、Sランク冒険者の僕は彼女を買って守ることにした
title.romaji: Issho ni Ken no Shugyou wo Shita Osananajimi ga Dorei ni Natteita node, S-Rank Boukensha no Boku wa Kanojo wo Katte Mamoru Koto ni Shita

152602.description:
Despite being very much alive, Merit finds herself lost in the Realm of the Dead! To get back home, she'll need help from the god Anubis. Only one problem...he's been cursed and wants nothing to do with humans or his job anymore. But the handsome, good-for-nothing god may care more than he lets on, and Merit is no quitter!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: メリトあいきゅうごっど

152604.description:
Soapy is a block of soap that loves muscular guys, especially his Master. Until one day when a rival, the liquid-soap Creamy, appeared in the bathroom! From jealous love-rivals to becoming soap bros, random appearances by the Master's family, and Soapy-kun's mysterious past, a hilarious story will unfold!

(Source: Books.tw, translated)

152605.description:
Attracted by that light—

(Source: Shonen Sirius, translated)

Note: Honorable Mention in the 51st Shonen Sirius Newcomer Prize

152606.description:
A bride walks through a desolate field... she is Konori, a girl eight years of age.
In order to save her town from starvation, she was offered as a bride to Gemuri, a fearsome demon. As she traveled across the desolate grasslands of the Yellow Sea Plain, what fierce destiny awaits the girl at the end of the journey!?

This collection of elegant works of Oriental fantasy Includes the title story and also "Kareno no Hanayome" (枯れ野の花嫁).

(Source: Homesha, translated)

152607.description:
The story starts in 13th=century Daxingfu, the capital of the Jin Dynasty, a kingdom exhausted by the Mongol invasion. Nergui, a former slave boy and a prodigy who can learn any language, lost everything in the "first air raid in history" launched by the Mongol army. Remembering the words of his best friend Bator, "If you want freedom, you must fight," Nergui vowed revenge against the Mongols. His weapon of choice is "words," and his opponent is the most powerful empire in history. A former slave boy will combine "knowledge" and "blood" in this epic historical drama!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

152608.description:
After a hundred years of monsters, it’s become the norm to train at hunter academies if you want to become a professional monster hunter. And that’s just what hard-working orphan Seojun Kim dreams of. But after a freak accident dashes his hopes, ads for the mysterious Transcendent Academy pop up on his phone, offering him a chance to train virtually with history’s most legendary warriors. As he levels up, he’s soon caught up in the world of hunter academies, dungeon raids, and competitive tournaments. But the more he learns, the more questions he has about the people surrounding him, his past, and the secrets of the Transcendent Academy.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 21 extra chapters.
synonyms: 超越者学院の受講生になった
สถาบันกวดวิชาสำหรับผู้เป็นเลิศ

152609.description:
After her mother is executed for treason, Princess Llewellyn is shunned by high society and stripped of her rightful claim to the throne. So lowly does she become, that she is left with no one to protect her when she is kidnapped by dark mages and cursed with a wicked spell of lust. With no choice but to satisfy her desires as the curse demands, Llewellyn finds herself falling into the arms of unexpected suitors. But this life of lust can only go on for so long before the flames of passion begin to burn out of control…

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Secret Bedroom of a Dejected Royal Daughter
捨てられた王女の秘密の寝室
ห้องนอนลับของเจ้าหญิงต้องสาป
La habitación secreta de la princesa abandonada

title.english: The Secret Bedroom of the Abandoned Princess

152610.description:
5-year-old palace maid Charlie knows that in this world, she will be murdered out of jealousy by the villainous empress at a young age. Her only sources of hope are her plan to escape the palace as soon as possible, and her best friend Rose, a fellow maid who's like a big sister to her. However, when Charlie discovers that the kind-hearted Rose is actually the empress in disguise, her plans come crashing down around her. Can Charlie stay close enough to the empress to make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Villain Empress Loves Me So Much
The Evil Empress Loves Me So much

152611.description:
Sharon is a warrior who defeated a vicious dragon a thousand years ago. One day, an unidentified man appears in front of Aru, who grew up longing for Sharon. "What? Are you that terrifying dragon? Besides, I'm that hero?!" A cute and sad romance fantasy of a dragon and a hero who reunited after a thousand years!

(Source: Naver, translated)

152612.description:
Cheryl is a well-to-do lady of Neus Castle and a beloved little sister to Melvin. But, the night before Melvin's coronation, in an evil scheme plotted by their power-hungry uncle, Cheryl and her brother's peaceful days at the castle come to an abrupt end. Just as she's about to face her doom, she is rescued by Felix, her brother's best friend and the lord of Blair Castle, under the pretense of marriage, as he declares war against anyone who attempts to murder his bride-to-be. Cheryl's married life with her brother's-friend-turned-husband begins with the news of this fake but life-saving matrimony.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: The Things Melvin Left Behind for Them
Ce que Melvin leur a laissé

152613.description:
When rogue pirate Francis Drake comes face-to-face with Elizabeth I, Queen of England, it looks like the end of the line for his crew. But instead, the scoundrel and the sovereign join forces to take down the Spanish Armada, forming one of history's most unlikely alliances. As they work together, this money-crazy man and power-hungry woman find that there may be something else that makes their hearts race... But in the midst of political turmoil and impending war, does love stand a chance?

(Source: Tapas)

152614.description:
A time when tyrants ruled. A prophecy has reached the country. A child born on the day of prophecy will bring great prosperity to the country. But the child can go crazy with slaughter and ruin the country. In order to prevent this, you have to live a full life. On that day of prophecy, the Crown Prince 'Tae-Ho' was born.

The story of 'Tae-Ho', the child of prophecy, and 'Hae-Su' who appeared before him.

(Source: Naver, translated)

152615.description:
Dani, a Jurchen girl who was saved by General Gyeol Seo during a bandit attack, has to serve tea for him in his house in Hanyang. However, she has to hide her true identity and pretend to be from Joseon, due to the rumors that the general slaughters Jurchen people, regardless of gender or age. Gyeol on the other hand, cannot drink clear water because of a tragic incident that happened when he was young, and has a lot of enemies who want to kill him. Can Dani and Gyeol Seo survive against all odds?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes three extra chapter.

152616.description:
When I was hit by a truck and opened my eyes, a completely different world unfolded before it.
This world is a little strange. No, there are only a couple of things that are strange.

First of all, women rule the country. And all her concubines are men. In addition, the next emperor is selected through competition rather than through a system of succession to the throne.
And the strangest thing is the fact that I am participating in the contest for the throne.

Ryu Jeong-Ha, a woman in her 20s in Korea who fell into a world where a woman becomes the emperor and her man becomes her concubine.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 艶肉嬲りパラダイス サンワコミックス

152618.description:
Seol Chae-woo is a top vocal talent at his university with a promising future seemingly his for the taking; until his life comes crashing down before his eyes. When his mother suddenly passes and his father’s business goes bankrupt, Chae-woo is now forced to work odd jobs to keep his crumbling family afloat. But when his uncle approaches him with the idea of becoming a Reset Partner - one who carries an alpha’s child for him in exchange for hefty compensation - Chae-woo has a choice to make. The only problem? The alpha in question is Chae-woo’s rival - the enigmatic dominant alpha Beom Euigeon. Will the two be able to put their differences aside and create beautiful music together, or will this low note in Chae-woo’s life become an indefinite song of sorrow?

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: ボンバーガール・トリプルエックス

152620.description: Ji-Won is a new Korean literature teacher. Highschool student San-Ha has been her neighbor for many years. To a student, school is his life. But to a teacher, school is just a workplace. They thought that not much would change, but reality begs to differ...

title.native: 友達の義母と姉に誘惑される話
title.romaji: Tomodachi no Gibo to Ane ni Yuuwaku Sareru Hanashi

title.native: 村の淫習で筆おろしされた結果
title.romaji: Mura no Inshuu de Fudeoroshi Sareta Kekka

title.native: 喪服未亡人のエロ本です
不倫してるOLを寝取る話
知人妻が泊まりに来た結果
title.romaji: Chijin Tsuma ga Tomari ni Kita Kekka

152627.description: Tatsuki, the elder sister who works for an advertising agency, and her younger brother Torao, a university student in the middle of his search for himself. Despite not being related by blood, they live their life together in a dirty apartment, while Tatsuki's days are full of stress and uncertainty.

title.native: 今夜すきやきじゃないけど
もっと！もっと！ヤラせてくれる先輩

152629.description: This is the story of Kumiko, granddaughter of the last Shogun Tokugawa Yoshinobu. She was born in the year before Great Kanto Earthquake (1922 / Taisho 11), and survived the turbulent times of 3 different periods Taisho, Showa and Heisei.
synonyms: Princess Tokugawa - A Happy Daily Life With The Princess Of The Last Shogun-

title.native: 徳川おてんば姫 ～最後の将軍のお姫さまとのゆかいな日常～
title.romaji: Tokugawa Otenba-hime: Saigo no Shougun no Ohime-sama to no Yukai na Nichijou

title.native: 僕の武器は攻撃力１の針しかない
title.romaji: Boku no Buki wa Kougeki-ryoku 1 no Harishikanai

152631.description:
If it's broke, just fix it! — Things break all the time, but Shuri and Naoto don't throw them away or buy new ones. No, they repair them! But… why do they live together!? This repair manga will make you want to take care of your possessions – as long as you know how it works, you can fix it.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: リ・ペア この世界は持続可能ですか?
title.romaji: RePAIR: Kono Sekai wa Jizoku Kanou desu ka?

152632.description:
"Good shoes will take you to good places." Those were the words Yusai Ayumi remembered when she took over her late mother's shoe-making workshop. As she makes each pair of shoes, it's as if she is casting a spell to help the wearer go a good place, by gently wrapping someone's first step every day. This is a story of a shoemaker who is still inexperienced, but still warm and caring.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)
synonyms: Good shoes take you good places.

152634.description:
He just wants to live a peaceful life without emotional ups and downs. He spends his days without any expectations, until a beautiful girl, Saya, who is the complete opposite of him in every way, appears in front of him. She has it all: good looks, popularity, and happiness, but for some reason, she suddenly and unilaterally declares that she and Kento are dating. She even kisses him.......? As his dull and gloomy life suddenly explodes with fireworks!?

(Source: Magazine Pocket, translated)

title.native: 壊れた僕らの戦略恋愛

synonyms: トールアンドショート

152637.description:
During summer school, the neighboring boy.
A chance encounter led to friendship. Then she became attracted to that boy pursuing his dream…
It's an ephemeral but dear memory.

(Source: Betsuma, translated)

152638.description:
When I pulled the book of forbidden knowledge from the shelves of the city library, I was lost, helpless, and afraid. Then my life suddenly jumped the rails, onto a track leading into a world of raving madness, and I will crush any insects who dared to stand in my way.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

152639.description: A oneshot published in Garo #66 (vol. 6, no. 12, Oct. 1969), from avant-garde mangaka Sasaki Maki.

152640.description:
Hao Jiamei is an ordinary employee who aspires to thrive in her career. After a drunken night, she wakes up next to a handsome stranger, and she pays him for the night. To her surprise, the stranger turns out to be her new boss, and he can't seem to leave her alone.

(Source: INKR)

title.english: My Boss Won't Stop Loving Me

152642.description:
I'm busy writing my e-book, taking classes, and having a crush on the hottest chick on campus. But why do I keep thinking of my friend?

(Source: Tooomics)
synonyms: これが僕らのシェアオフィス物語

152643.description:
The "Dirty Talk, Dirty Stories" club is only for people into dirty things... But could romance flourish there too?

(Source: Toomics)

152645.description:
I need to focus on work, but I keep getting distracted by my coworkers!

(Source: Toomics)

152647.description:
Shi-Woo Jeong is trying to catch his big break when everything falls apart. He gets accused of stalking a star actor and is blacklisted by his high school crush, Tae-Rim Han, who now runs a successful acting agency. Tae-Rim decides to follow up on the disgraced actor only to realize Shi-Woo’s life is in shambles. He takes Shi-Woo in to set him straight, but discovers that there may be more to this talentless hack. Can Tae-Rim add such a risk to his agency’s roster and make something of Shi-Woo while his romantic feelings resurface?

(Source: Tapas)

152648.description:
Papa is a househusband and Mama is a manga artist.
A comic essay full of recipes from the Sakurazawa family!

After more than 20 years of leaving housework to her stay-at-home husband and concentrating on her manga, Erica Sakurazawa finally started to cook occasionally. Her husband's specialty is ethnic food, grandma offers nostalgic dishes when she comes over, her adult son makes dishes learned from his part-time job, her college daughter can make desserts, and the pasta that is always popular with her children, who say, "When Mama makes it, it has a special sparkle......." 30 recipes from the family of four at papa's table.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 家事しない主婦と三世代の食卓
title.romaji: Kaji Shinai Shufu to Sansedai no Shokutaku

152649.description:
I am young and pretty. 'Pure'? Maybe, maybe not. My future was guaranteed when I signed that contract. My life was a success. There was no such thing as 'failure'... until I met him.

(Source: Toomics)

152650.description:
Choi Taeshik lives a quiet, normal life. He works hard at the office, takes good care of his body, occasionally goes on dates, and tries his best to be a responsible adult. One day two sisters down on their luck show up outside his work and ask for a place to live. Even though he finds out they are old family friends, how can Taeshik live with two girls? Just the thought makes him uncomfortable. After originally agreeing to let them stay for just one night, one of the sisters tempts Taeshik with a mutually beneficial offer he just can’t refuse! Will Taeshik be able to successfully navigate the sudden addition of two tantalizing roommates?

(Source: Lezhin X)
synonyms: かまって姉妹と同棲生活

152651.description:
After centuries of war, the Avian and Serpent races agree to a tentative peace and joint training of cadets. Instructor Sahwahyun, an admired Avian war hero, maintains a strict composure that keeps all students at bay—except Yahyul, an unassuming Serpent cadet harboring hidden depths beneath his stoic shell. As their paths intertwine through subtle encounters, a halting bond forms that soon blossoms beyond mere camaraderie into something deeper that defies the boundaries between their races.

(Source: Tapas)

152652.description:
Everyone has at least one dirty little secret.

As a result of a game started by her father, Ellie grew up unable to speak or write very well. Knowing her condition, three men disclose their deepest secrets to her. However, just as they begin taking an interest in her, Ellie disappears. She's eventually found, but this time, she can speak!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 失って初めて気づいた

152653.description:
On the fateful day the dragons first appeared, Dr. Abe's beloved died in the initial onslaught. Now he has created an android in his own image: the DS-08 "Shikigami," part of the NUN (New United Nations)'s top secret project to counter this monstrous invasion. In addition to the Shikigami, this team of "Dragonslayers" is comprised of members of the many races that have up till now lived in obscurity: elves, dwarves, witches, vampires, and more... As the team assembles to fight off the massive and mysterious creatures that now menace humanity, however, one member stands apart from the rest: Momo Agatsuma, the young daughter of an NUN scientist and ace pilot par excellence. Together this motley crew must fend off the greatest threat the world has ever faced...!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

152654.description:
World’s first SSS-ranked genius hunter, Junu Kim. He regresses ten years into the past after being ambushed by unknowns one day. With all his hunter skills now locked, he must fulfill his career as a dungeon cleaner to unlock them. But this cleaner… is extraordinary! The once renowned hunter, Junu Kim, takes over the cleaning duty with vigorous determination.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Clever Cleaning Life of the Returned Genius Hunter
สุดยอดฮันเตอร์สายคลีน

title.english: The Dungeon Cleaning Life of a Once Genius Hunter

152655.description:
In the beginning of the Flood, the Great Dao was ruthless and took all things as fodder. A young boy from the human race falls to the south and stumbles onto the path of cultivation, struggling for survival, fighting for his life with his sword.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

152656.description:
A white-haired beauty. A mysterious power. A night of passion. Kiheon lived an ordinary existence until the day Baek-yeo entered his life. The mysterious ashen-haired child would whisper visions of the future to Kiheon’s grandfather, allowing for a life of prosperity and success. Confident that the two would be fine on their own, Kiheon left to pursue life as an everyday businessman. Years later, on the night of his grandfather’s passing, the two are reunited. Baek-yeo, now a foxy beauty in his maturity, comes to Kiheon with a proposition: grant me a child, and I will ensure you success with your business. After their fiery fling the two part ways, never to see each other again…or at least, that’s what Kiheon thinks. Four years later, a call from home reveals the truth of that night: Baek-yeo is actually a kumiho – a nine-tailed fox with the ability to see the future…and apparently, get pregnant! Now Kiheon must not only learn how to be a father, but also how to keep Baek-yeo by his side forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Clandestine Marriage of a Fox

152658.description:
The scorching sun. The golden desert and the blue sea! After working hard for 3 years, Kyu-Hyun goes on a trip to the African desert as a gift to himself. While trying to enjoy a healing life, Kyu-Hyun gets caught in a huge sandstorm and gets seriously injured, losing consciousness, and Neferti saves him. After a dreamlike kiss, he comes to his senses and wonders where he is?! And the animals are talking?!! Kyu-Hyun despairs when he hears that no one has returned to where they were, but he starts to get excited, wondering if he might meet the mysterious man who saved him...

(Source: Peenutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 11 side story chapters.
synonyms: The Priest-nim Is Ah Ya! Hey

152659.description:
After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day. Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire. As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires.

(Source: Lezhin US)

152660.description:
Gangju Lee is a new star in the K-pop world. When a stalker starts to get too close, his CEO insists on hiring a security detail. Han-ah Dae is now in charge of Gangju’s protection and deems it safest that the two live together. Gangju initially rejects the idea until he sees the many benefits of having an extremely hot roommate who will guard him at all costs and has a knack for anticipating even his most minor needs. And Gangju has some pretty big needs that only Han-ah is equipped to fill…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Please, take care of Kang Joo!
ฝากคังจูด้วยนะ

152661.description:
Ho-Yeon Baek is fed up with his bad luck. That phony shaman telling him his nightmares are the result of being haunted by spirits was one thing, but sleeping with a hundred different souls in a human body to get rid of those dreams is another! The body in question? Dan Choi, dreamboat celebrity. He’s just as haunted as Ho-Yeon, but that’s nothing compared to the sadness he seems to carry inside. Strange powers brought them together, but could this odd relationship turn into something more?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: A Tale of a Hundred Nights

152663.description:
Saki Asahina has a secret... though everyone at work thinks she's a true beauty, once her makeup comes off, she's as red as an octopus! Having been cruelly bullied in the past for how she looks, Saki has put years of effort into perfecting her makeup game! Now she's never lacking in attention (or the gossip that comes with it), but she has yet to catch the eye of her boss, Fujimichi Bansho, who she's had a crush on for years.

One night, while out buying beer and with her makeup off, Saki finds herself being asked out by her boss, who doesn't realize who she is! Just who has he mistaken her for? How long can she keep her makeup-less face a secret?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Me That You Love, The Me That I Hate
title.native: あなたの恋する 嫌いなわたし
title.romaji: Anata no Koisuru Kirai na Watashi

152664.description:
The best way to get some summer chills...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2022-08

152665.description: In high school, Rintaro Tsujido burned with passion for road racing. However, when his father caused an unexpected accident, Rintaro needed a large sum of money for medical treatment, leading him to choose the path of keirin racing. Over time, he became captivated by the allure of keirin and set his sights on becoming a top rider faster than anyone else. He achieved three consecutive victories in the A-class races, proudly earning his promotion to the S-class riders. However, the barrier of the S-class proved to be higher than he imagined...

title.native: セイギノミカタ～完堕ち～

152667.description:
Life is going well for Hidaka. He has good interpersonal relationships, has a nice face and is entrusted with a big project. His life is set on easy mode, hiding behind a facade of his prince-like appearance. That is until one day, Tachibana, a handsome and elite junior joins the company and finds out about Hidaka’s true nature! With a devious smile, Tachibana successfully lures Hidaka in with drinks and they end up in bed?!
“Can we keep seeing each other if we’re fuck buddies?” A bite mark is the proof of submission? Cunning Elite S Junior x Charlatan Beauty Salary Man.

(Source|: LiQulle, translated and edited)

Chapter count includes an extra

152668.description:
On the day he dumps his cheating ex, salaryman Taeyoon Han meets two gorgeous guys: friendly coffee shop owner Yehan and stubborn businessman Jaehyuk. The two couldn’t be more different, but one thing’s for certain: they both want to please Taeyoon in bed. Drunk and craving affection, Taeyoon gives in to his desires… which ends in a one-night-stand threesome! Taeyoon is sure it’s a one-time mistake, but wait! Yehan and Jaehyuk want to continue the threesome?! So begins not one, not two… but three times the fun in bed.

(Source: Tapas)

152669.description: This manga is about The First (Self-Proclaimed) Boy Police Officer Komawari, who is the main character, and his classmates at the "Gyakukou Elementary School" he attends.

152670.description:
My jealousy for you has now turned into love. Will you forgive me for ruining your life?

(Source: Lalatoon)

title.native: 機神大戦ギガンティック・フォーミュラ

title.english: The Path to Salvation for a Zombie Girl is Creampie Sex
title.native: ゾンビっ娘の救済は中出しSEXで
title.romaji: Zombiekko no Kyuusai wa Nakadashi SEX de

synonyms: The Sadistic Professor's Case Report - Breaking the Rookie Female Investigator!

title.native: 東京ブラックボックス〜ドS教授の難事件レポート〜
title.romaji: Tokyo Black Box: Do S Kyouju no Nanjiken Report

title.english: H Camp ~Diary of the Screw-Around Outdoors Club~
title.native: えちキャン〜ヤリモク野外活動部日誌〜

152675.description:
1. Danzai no Kyoukai (断罪の教会)
2. S Gakuen: Ojou-sama-tachi no Maso Otoko Choukyou (S学園~お嬢様達のマゾ男調教~)
3. Mori no Majo: Kyousei Jinkaku Haishutsu Shasei (森の魔女~強制人格排出射精~)
4. Private Lesson (プライベートレッスン)
5. Double Lesson (ダブルレッスン)

Mori no Majo: Kyousei Jinkaku Haishutsu Shasei

152676.description:
1-2. Oba-Shota Harem: Shounen to Danchizuma-tachi (おばしょたハーレム-少年と団地妻達-)
3-5 Shinshoku Shima (侵蝕島)
synonyms: おばしょたハーレム-少年と団地妻達-

152678.description: Note: This is a manga adaption of a side story of Sakuranbo Elementary School's visual novel "Itazura Love Hitoke no Nai Kouen de Shoujo to Ai wo Hagukumou".

title.native: いたずラブ ひと気のない公園で少女と愛を育もう フルカラーブック
title.romaji: Itazura Love Hitoke no Nai Kouen de Shoujo to Ai wo Hagukumou: Full Color Book

152679.description: Note: This is a manga adaption of a side story of Sakuranbo Elementary School's visual novel "Kouen Itazura Simulator ver. Mako".

152680.description:
In this school, "semen duty" means having to be the cum receptacle for all the boys in the class.
But this time, the teacher joins in too.
Life is tough for young girls recently!

Note: This is a manga adaption of a side story of the scenario "Grade 5 Semen Duty" from Sakuranbo Elementary School's visual novel "Rokan12 : How They Feel on the Inside". Misaki Sogo returns!

152837.description:
It is the year 2205. The “Historical Revisionists” have begun attacking the past. In order to prevent history from being altered, the Time Government has sent “Saniwa” to the past. Awakened by these Saniwa are the tsukumogami dwelling in swords, “Touken Danshi”. In order to protect history, they throw themselves into battle. The Saniwa gives their Touken Danshi the order to go on a new sortie. They assign a formation with Hachisuka Kotetsu as the captain, Kashuu Kiyomitsu, Yamatonokami Yasusada, Izuminokami Kanesada, Horikawa Kunihiro and Nagasone Kotetsu. Hachisuka Kotetsu is rubbed the wrong way by the existence of Nagasone Kotetsu, who is a forgery.

The stage is the first year of the Genji era (1864). The target of the Historical Revisionists is the Shinsengumi. Kashuu Kiyomitsu and Yamatonokami Yasusada were Okita Souji's swords, Izuminokami Kanesada and Horikawa Kunihiro were Hijikata Toshizo's swords, and Nagasone Kotetsu was Kondo Isami's sword. Seeing their former masters makes the Touken Danshi waver. However, the presence of the History Retrograde army, under the command of the Historical Revisionists, draws near them. What is the meaning of Yamatonokami Yasusada's actions, as the goal of the History Retrograde Army remains unknown...?

On a cold winter day, Toko gets dumped on her first date because of her weight...

As she staggers through town in shock, she bumps into a man and sprains her ankle.
Thinking her night couldn't get any worse, she's taken care of and comforted by the hottie who knocked her down?to the point where she starts crying.
A few days later, Toko decides to get in shape. As it turns out, Aoi, the handsome man from the other night, is a personal trainer. Toko decides to take him up on his offer to help her get in shape! Though Aoi doesn't show any emotion, he's kind and great at his job. It also helps that Toko's got a thing for muscle-clad hunks...

Murdered in cold blood, Emperor Levenoad of Strahss is reincarnated as a slave named Ray in the enemy empire of El Fascher! To make matters worse, he's caught the eye of the emperor, Jiskar, and gets dragged off to the palace as his concubine. In order to escape, Ray must spread his legs for Jiskar in order to win his favor, all while carefully avoiding the jealous, power-hungry empress and crown prince who will do anything to tear him down. More importantly, he must figure out who killed him in his past life... and why. Unfortunately, none of this will prove to be easy with guards at his side 24/7 and his feet in shackles. Will Ray be able to find freedom while uncovering the truth about his past? Or is he doomed to be forever chained in the palace of the enemy empire?

However, his excitement is dashed when he logs in to find that his partner healer is enlisting in the military that very day! Unable to tackle the new raid without his crucial partner, JJA posts a recruitment notice for new team members. Yet, is able to pass the most difficult requirement of them all: a one-on-one interview. After a day of meticulously managing his block list and flooding the chat with ♡♡s, a surprising newcomer appears—a perfect partner seemingly sent from the devs themselves! Eun-Ha Lee is a smart, successful lawyer who has life figured out... that is, until she loses both her parents in a tragic accident and divorces her husband, Tae-Yang, a famous actor, who she discovers has been cheating on her. Things take a turn for the surreal after Eun-Ha slips on a staircase only to wake up in her past. She is now 22 years old and back in law school. He was biding his time and accumulated influence and strength in the shadows. A trashy male lead and a trashy female lead both transmigrated together. 152969.description:
Grown-ups have always told Yu-Fan that a girl should act like a girl: learn the piano; be quiet and dignified rather than noisy and rough; and wear skirts. Under pressure from her mother and grandmother, Yu-Fan has no choice but to hide who she really is and dress up as the girl they want her to be.

One day, she learns her mother carried out that Daoist ritual while she was pregnant, in order to ensure a boy. And as she reaches puberty, she realizes she is not developing in the same way as the other girls and becomes even more confused. Then a cousin she has always looked up to invites her to an LGBT event, helps her learn about herself, and takes her to a gay wedding. Things start to become clearer for Yu-Fan.
synonyms: A Hundred Flowers, a Hundred Colors

152970.description:
What if one day you found out to be sharing a soul with another person from a different time? And what if that person is no other than a historical figure ruling over the kingdom?

Sian was living a tragic life. Her parents had passed away, and her uncle and aunt, who took her, treated her basely without showing any affection. Her day-to-day misery finally takes an upturn when she gets sucked into a fantastical world she only read about in her books. When she opens her eyes, she is holding an Excalibur in front of the people who are too dazed to speak. When they come to their senses, people start to call her Queen Arthur. Everything is a blur, and Sian can't make out what's happening until she learns she is sharing a soul with King Arthur Pendragon.

Sian's adventure of becoming a queen begins, and it appears smooth sailing until she learns that she bears a mission, and that is to get a hold of the Holy Grail and correct the mistakes of King Arthur, ensuring that the people in the Kingdom of Britain will live happily ever after. Surrounded by her knights, the great wizard, and enemies, she sets out on the journey of becoming a wise and loving queen who wants to bring peace and happiness to this land.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

152971.description:
Brienne Lutengard knew that her parents were selling off their daughter and their status in exchange for money. Still, she thought she’d be able to live a relatively happy life with her husband, but it’s not long until the new duke of House Lutengard shatters her dreams. Eight years later, the duke is found murdered in his residence, and Brienne is named the main suspect, along with three potential accomplices. All three are skilled swordsmen, none have an alibi for the night of the murder, and they’re all young men recently caught up in a scandal with the duchess! Did the duchess really kill her husband? And if so, what could’ve been her motive?

(Source: Tappytoon)

152972.description:
The "merciful dragon" died. The imperial dragon, the symbol of the empire, has died. But it was something everyone knew. Jaha was an old dragon and everyone knew that his life would soon end. Moreover, the imperial family had a young dragon to carry on the next contract, so no one was confused. A knight from the Imperial Palace Safety Planning Department, Jinyoung Killis, is tasked with protecting the dragon's master who lost the dragon. Se Hyeon, the dragon's contractor, looks like a girl of about seventeen, but is actually a 123-year-old grandmother. It is the knight's job to protect her until she completes her promised mission with her dragon. But the only missions she promised the dragon were strange things, such as "shouting at a concert," "talking with friends," "praying at the graves of her mom and dad," "going to a casino," and "going to an amusement park." It seems funny, but if she fails to perform her contract or dies, it is said that a national catastrophe such as an earthquake, tsunami, storms, volcanic eruptions, etc. will happen to the whole empire as a result...!
